name: Azrael
source:
Azu is [url=/c1509]Krile[/url]'s talking stuffed cat. Azu speaks like some kind of gang boss and loves to order Shizuma around even though it can’t really do anything. Krile responds to Azu’s wild yammerings with sudden acts of violence, leading it to squeal and scream while begging for mercy. They certainly are… a unique duo. 

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=374]m3rryweather's review[/url]]

Azrael is the official mascot character of [url=/p81]Lump of Sugar[/url] who appears in all of their games in a way or another.
